results.title: PlayAd Review & Alternative (2026) — ViralMojo
results.content:
PlayAd is a San Francisco startup building a managed "AI marketing team": named agent "employees" that take your brief, produce the creative, A/B test it, and buy the media across channels — with marketer-owned interactive/playable ads as its flagship wedge. It has announced a $5.4M raise to expand that agent team. Pricing runs Intern $39/mo (330 credits, 1 ad account) → Part Time $99 → Full Time $499 → CMO $1,799 → Enterprise custom, with yearly billing 20% cheaper; the homepage says it is free to start with no credit card (checked September 2026 — note its own page title still says "starting at $59/mo"). As of September 2026 there's no dedicated third-party review base yet — the Trustpilot page you'll find under "PlayAd" belongs to play.ai, a different company. It fits teams that want [...] Comparison pages have a trust problem — most shade the truth. Every competitor fact on this page is checked against public sources on the date shown, the ✕ marks on our own side are real, and the ads in the receipts table are public links you can verify. If anything here is out of date or unfair to the competitor, tell me and I'll fix it.

— Denzel,@denzelgeng7 on X

FAQ

## Should you switch from PlayAd? [...] PlayAd does — one of its named AI "team members" is a media buyer that publishes and runs spend across channels (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, and more). ViralMojo does not publish to your ad account or spend a dollar of your budget. It does the research and writes the hooks and scripts; you decide what to shoot, what to launch, and where. That's the core difference: PlayAd is a managed loop you hand control to, ViralMojo is a tool you drive.

results.content:
Historically, however, interactive ads have been powerful yet impractical - slow to build, prohibitively expensive, and dependent on specialized developers. Playad makes them fast enough to iterate and simple enough for marketers to own, which changes creative from a bottleneck into a repeatable workflow at a fraction of cost. In addition, Playad is designed for rapid experimentation, and teams can A/B test interactive ads by instantly creating a wide range of variations.

While interactive formats are the initial wedge, Playad is built as a broader AI-native creative platform, enabling teams to create and iterate across image, video, and interactive formats within a single system.
